mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hot_scenic(`scenic_id`, `scenic_name`, `count`, `stat_date`) VALUES (#{scenicId}, #{scenicName}, 1, #{statDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `count` = `count` + 1, `scenic_name` = VALUES(`scenic_name`)
mapper.select: SELECT scenic_id as scenicId, scenic_name as scenicName, SUM(count) as count FROM hot_scenic WHERE stat_date >= #{startDate} AND stat_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY scenic_id, scenic_name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
